quotes.quote: Patience is the art of concealing your impatience.
quotes.author: Guy Kawasaki

quotes.quote: Hope is patience with the lamp lit.
quotes.author: Tertullian

quotes.quote: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness, and the word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness. It is far better take things as they come along with patience and equanimity.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.quote: I have seen many storms in my life. Most storms have caught me by surprise, so I had to learn very quickly to look further and understand that I am not capable of controlling the weather, to exercise the art of patience and to respect the fury of nature.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: God's way of answering the Christian's prayer for more patience, experience, hope and love often is to put him into the furnace of affliction.
quotes.author: Richard Cecil

quotes.quote: I like to see people reunited, I like to see people run to each other, I like the kissing and the crying, I like the impatience, the stories that the mouth can't tell fast enough, the ears that aren't big enough, the eyes that can't take in all of the change, I like the hugging, the bringing together, the end of missing someone.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: Rivers know this: there is no hurry. We shall get there some day.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne,  Winnie-the-Pooh

quotes.quote: A man with a silver spoon may get his share of supporters, but he can never be an inspiration for somebody! Patience and hard work are the key to every man's success.
quotes.author: Kailash Kher

quotes.quote: Patience, grasshopper,"said Maia. "Good things come to those who wait.""I always thought that was 'Good things come to those who do the wave,'"said Simon. "No wonder I've been so confused all my life.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

quotes.quote: Trees that are slow to grow bear the best fruit.
quotes.author: MoliÃ¨re

quotes.quote: Things need not have happened to be true. Tales and dreams are the shadow-truths that will endure when mere facts are dust and ashes, and forgot.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 3: Dream Country

quotes.quote: The two hardest tests on the spiritual road are the patience to wait for the right moment and the courage not to be disappointed with what we encounter.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Veronika Decides to Die

quotes.quote: Heaven grant us patience with a man in love.
quotes.author: Rudyard Kipling

quotes.quote: While it is true that Frank had a great sense of humor, he was also very serious about composing music. In reality there are only a handful of skilled players who can play his most complex pieces. It takes a lot of patience to learn and requires a fantastic memory.
quotes.author: Dweezil Zappa

quotes.quote: He was the crazy one who had painted himself black and defeated the world.She was the book thief without the words.Trust me, though, the words were on their way, and when they arrived, Liesel would hold them in her hands like the clouds, and she would wring them out like rain.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

quotes.quote: I just did some calculations and I've been able to determine that you're full of shit.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: There are times to stay put, and what you want will come to you, and there are times to go out into the world and find such a thing for yourself.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  Horseradish

quotes.quote: Kindness is really important to me in finding my own prince - so are patience and a sense of humor. Without those qualities he's no Prince Charming!
quotes.author: Anne Hathaway

quotes.quote: He that can have patience can have what he will.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: Faith is not simply a patience that passively suffers until the storm is past. Rather, it is a spirit that bears things - with resignations, yes, but above all, with blazing, serene hope.
quotes.author: Corazon Aquino

quotes.quote: To say that one waits a lifetime for his soulmate to come around is a paradox. People eventually get sick of waiting, take a chance on someone, and by the art of commitment become soulmates, which takes a lifetime to perfect.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: Sometimes we may ask God for success, and He gives us physical and mental stamina. We might plead for prosperity, and we receive enlarged perspective and increased patience, or we petition for growth and are blessed with the gift of grace. He may bestow upon us conviction and confidence as we strive to achieve worthy goals.
quotes.author: David A. Bednar

quotes.quote: I told her I'd wait forever for her, but that was before I found somebody else who'd give me a ride home.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Patience and wisdom walk hand in hand, like two one-armed lovers.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

quotes.quote: I believe that a trusting attitude and a patient attitude go hand in hand. You see, when you let go and learn to trust God, it releases joy in your life. And when you trust God, you're able to be more patient. Patience is not just about waiting for something... it's about how you wait, or your attitude while waiting.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: Everybody going to be dead one day, just give them time.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  Anansi Boys

quotes.quote: Sometimes your light shines so bright that it blinds people from seeing who you really are.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: There's no advantage to hurrying through life."-Shikamaru Nara
quotes.author: Masashi Kishimoto

quotes.quote: Love isn't in a hurry like a flurry of flowery words on paper. It's lush and slow to grow its aroma in the garden of time.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I used to think how lucky she was to have me, but now I realize that's backwards. A spirit of gratitude yields patience, love, and forgiveness.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: You can never be too early to stand around and wait. You can have a seat in this chair, after I cinch the noose around my neck and you kick it out from under my legs.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If I offer you a glass of water, and bring back a cup of ice, I'm trying to teach you patience. And also that sometimes you get ice with no water, and later you'll get water with no ice. Ah, but that's life, no?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Ah, but that's life, no?

quotes.quote: Time has no meaning,Love will endure..
quotes.author: Jude Deveraux

quotes.quote: I am a fisherman among farmers, and as a farmer what I grow is tired of waiting for her to love me.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I wrote you a love letter, and I sent it snail mail. Love is forever, and that's about how long it'll take to get to you.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I will not deny but that the best apology against false accusers is silence and sufferance, and honest deeds set against dishonest words.
quotes.author: John Milton

quotes.quote: Persistence. Perfection. Patience. Power. Prioritize your passion. It keeps you sane.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Love waits patiently. In the lobby. I'll be with you as soon as I can.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

quotes.quote: I don't mind waiting rooms. I'm waiting on the love of my life, so I may as well have a seat, right?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Whenever You're Gone, I'm Here For You

quotes.quote: Wisdom is knowing when you are being patient, and when you are wasting time by waiting.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Patience is so valuable I'm willing to wait forever to achieve it. And while I wait, I may as well get busy being short-tempered.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Don't let mental blocks control you. Set yourself free. Confront your fear and turn the mental blocks into building blocks.
quotes.author: Roopleen,  Words to inspire the winner in YOU

quotes.quote: I heard a preacher say recently that hope is a revolutionary patience; let me add that so is being a writer. Hope begins in the dark, the stubborn hope that if you just show up and try to do the right thing, the dawn will come. You wait and watch and work: you don't give up.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott,  Bird by Bird: Some Instructions on Writing and Life

quotes.quote: Restlessness and impatience change nothing except our peace and joy. Peace does not dwell in outward things, but in the heart prepared to wait trustfully and quietly on Him who has all things safely in His hands.
quotes.author: Elisabeth Elliot

quotes.quote: This is one more piece of advice I have for you: don't get impatient. Even if things are so tangled up you can't do anything, don't get desperate or blow a fuse and start yanking on one particular thread before it's ready to come undone. You have to realize it's going to be along process and that you'll work on things slowly, one at a time.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

quotes.quote: Try looking at your mind as a wayward puppy that you are trying to paper train. You don't drop-kick a puppy into the neighbor's yard every time it piddles on the floor. You just keep bringing it back to the newspaper.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott,  Bird by Bird: Some Instructions on Writing and Life

quotes.quote: Fear is the glue that keeps you stuck. Faith is the solvent that sets you free.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: She said she was a nurse. I replied that she must have a lot of patience--and patients. I would have said more, but I ran out of homophones.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Write like no one is reading 3

quotes.quote: The soul hardly ever realizes it, but whether he is a believer or not, his loneliness is really a homesickness for God.
quotes.author: Hubert Van Zeller

quotes.quote: Inner peace is impossible without patience. Wisdom requires patience. Spiritual growth implies the mastery of patience. Patience allows the unfolding of destiny to proceed at its won unhurried pace.
quotes.author: Brian L. Weiss,  Muchas Vidas, Muchos Maestros

quotes.quote: Think of the patience God has had for you and let it resonate to others. If you want a more patient world, let patience be your motto
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: If you're serious about sanctification, you can expect to experience heart-wrenching moments that try your faith, your endurance, and your patience.
quotes.author: Sheri Dew,  If Life Were Easy, It Wouldn't Be Hard: And Other Reassuring Truths

quotes.quote: Patience ensures victory.
quotes.author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S

quotes.quote: Tell me what's the differencebetween hope and waitingbecause my heart doesn't knowIt constantly cuts itself on the glass of waitingIt constantly gets lost in the fog of hope
quotes.author: Anna KamieÅ„ska

quotes.quote: How do new watches catch up with old watches that have had more time to get a head start? This is what I pondered while I waited on her to fall in love with me.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The common man prays, 'I want a cookie right now!' And God responds, 'If you'd listen to what I say, tomorrow it will bring you 100 cookies.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Aura, I'm really patient, but I'm not a bloody saint.
quotes.author: Jeri Smith-Ready,  Shade

quotes.quote: If I could store any character quality in a cookie jar, I'd store patience. Chocolate-chip patience cookies. And I'd eat them all at one sitting.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If I saw a hitchhiker wearing a tie-dyed shirt, I'd assume he's been waiting for a ride since the 1960s. I think that kind of patience is groovy.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: There is something good in all seeming failures. You are not to see that now. Time will reveal it. Be patient.
quotes.author: Sivananda Saraswati

quotes.quote: Be patient. Your skin took a while to deteriorate. Give it some time to reflect a calmer inner state. As one of my friends states on his Facebook profile: "The true Losers in Life, are not those who Try and Fail, but those who Fail to Try.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  Clear: A Guide to Treating Acne Naturally

quotes.quote: Your least favorite virtue, or nominee for the most overrated one? Faith. Closely followed--in view of the overall shortage of time--by patience.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens,  Hitch-22: A Memoir

quotes.quote: Patience, persistence and perspiration make an unbeatable combination for success.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: What good has impatience ever brought? It has only served as the mother of mistakes and the father of irritation.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: No beating yourself up. That's not allowed. Be patient with yourself. It took you years to form the bad habits of thought that you no longer want. It will take a littletime to form new and better ones. But I promise you this: Even a slight move in this direction will bring you some peace. The more effort you apply to it, the faster you'll find your bliss, but you'll experience rewards immediately.
quotes.author: Holly Mosier

quotes.quote: How many a man has thrown up his hands at a time when a little more effort, a little more patience would have achieved success.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: Maybe that's why life is so precious. No rewind or fast forward...just patience and faith.
quotes.author: Cristina Marrero

quotes.quote: I look in the mirror through the eyes of the child that was me.
quotes.author: Judy Collins

quotes.quote: A life is not a waste of time
quotes.author: Nalini Singh,  Angels' Blood

quotes.quote: Miro, I'm so sorry. I always felt such pity for you humans because you could only think of one thing at a time and your memories were so imperfect and . . . now I realize that just getting through the day without killing somebody can be an achievement."It gets to be a habit. Most of us manage to keep our body count quite low. It's the neighborly way to live.
quotes.author: Orson Scott Card,  Children of the Mind

quotes.quote: For the wise have always known that no one can make much of his life until self-searching has become a regular habit, until he is able to admit and accept what he finds, and until he patiently and persistently tries to correct what is wrong. - Bill W.
quotes.author: Bill W.

quotes.quote: Though the mills of God grind slowly, yet they grind exceeding small; Though with patience He stands waiting, with exactness grinds He all.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: Patience is the direct antithesis of anger.
quotes.author: Allan Lokos,  Pocket Peace: Effective Practices for Enlightened Living

quotes.quote: The secret code of success is patience,a virtue that can not be replaced. It takes time to build great dreams.
quotes.author: Bernard Kelvin Clive

quotes.quote: Because you don't learn anything unless you can find the patience to read. TV takes that away from you. It robs you from your mind.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  Underdog

quotes.quote: If the river has a soul, it's a peaceful one. If it has a lesson to impart, that lesson is patience. There will be drought, it says; there will be floods; the ice will form, the ice will melt; the water will flow and blend into the river's brackish mouth, then join the ocean between Lewes and Cape May, endlessly, forever, amen.
quotes.author: Therese Anne Fowler,  Z: A Novel of Zelda Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: Peaceful disputes are maintained when men sincerely believe that they are morally, logically correct about the issues at hand. It is when neither side is really certain that wars are instigated.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Patience and persistence are the keys... The keys to unlock doors of success... With these two virtues, you grow in reasoning and experience.
quotes.author: Ogwo David Emenike

quotes.quote: When you mature in your relationship with God you realize how suffering and patience are like eating your spiritual vegetables.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: Don't settle for anyone just to have a someone. Be patient. Have faith and wait for the right one.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Bourgeret

quotes.quote: Knowing trees, I came to realize, understand and appreciate the act of patience.
quotes.author: Ogwo David Emenike

quotes.quote: Patience is the art of hoping.
quotes.author: Luc de Clapiers

quotes.quote: The creation of man is evidence for the love of God, the preservation of man is evidence for the patience of God, and Christ is evidence for the forgiveness of God. It is when we are wrapped up in our own little peeves that we begin to displace His benevolence with malevolence.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: There are three qualities that every individual must have to achieve success: a Monk's patience, a Warrior's courage, a Child's imagination.
quotes.author: Sharad Vivek Sagar

quotes.quote: Success needs vision to see, passion to transcend, patience to withstand and the character to overcome failures.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Walking the Path of Compassion

quotes.quote: The tower of success stands on the pillars of vision, action, patience and the character to withstand criticisms.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Walking the Path of Compassion

quotes.quote: No rain can't get the rainbow.
quotes.author: ayumi hamasaki rainbow

quotes.quote: The world is always in a hurry, but I teach My children patience. Live, expecting a full and joyous life. And learn to trust My perfect timing so that you may discover that all the pain found in waiting has a magnificent and awesome purpose.
quotes.author: Eric Ludy,  When God Writes Your Love Story

quotes.quote: Create your own path.Don't blindly follow the massess... because most of the time the "M"is silent.
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quotes.quote: Your friends can be double-edged knife thy can either nurture you or destroy you. Choose them Wisely......
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely
